claim_boundary: Computed on D12 confirmation rows that were already opened. Observational, not causal: it adjusts for composition, it does not intervene on it. It licenses no exclusion of the composition explanation and exists only to motivate and power D13.

definitions.delta_cpg: per tile cover: CpG_dinucleotide_count(target cover) / (length - 1) minus the same rate for the control cover; aggregated to a per-locus contrast identically to delta_gc
definitions.delta_gc: per tile cover: GC_fraction(target cover) - GC_fraction(control cover); then per locus, mean over present downstream tiles minus mean over present upstream tiles, identically to how polarity aggregates target_specific_loss
definitions.matched_unmatched_split: loci ranked ascending by abs(delta_gc); the lower floor(n/2) form the best-matched half, the remaining ceil(n/2) form the worst-matched half
definitions.polarity: per locus: mean(target_specific_loss, present downstream tiles) - mean(target_specific_loss, present upstream tiles); >=1 tile required per side (D12 E2_tss_polarity's own completeness rule and tile set)
